display.purpose: The site brand/H1 only — the single largest, most identity-carrying text on the page.

headline.purpose: A classification's own name, in the detail panel and quiz result screen.

title.purpose: Section intros and the quiz question — one step down from a proper name.

body.purpose: Running copy: descriptions, taglines, hints. Always measure-capped, never full width.

label.purpose: Small uppercase tracked eyebrow text that organizes everything else — diagnostic tags, section headers, branch pills.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Shared soft two-layer shadow for card hover, tooltips, and the serif-spectrum zoom popover. Swaps to a black-based rgba pair in dark mode via the --shadow custom property.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Heavier, more diffuse shadow reserved for the detail overlay panel. Not currently swapped for dark mode (hardcoded rgba) — worth revisiting if the modal reads too light-shadowed on dark backgrounds.

shadows.name: lens
shadows.purpose: Tight, directional shadow under the circular anatomy magnifier only. Also not currently dark-mode-swapped.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default interactive transition — hover color/border/transform changes on tabs, chips, cards, quiz options.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: View-switch fade-in (opacity + 4px translateY), also used at 0.3s for the quiz result reveal.

motion.name: ease-float
motion.purpose: Appearance/disappearance of floating elements — the anatomy lens, era tooltips, the serif-spectrum zoom popover — paired with a small opacity+scale or opacity+translateY change.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Only hard breakpoint in the system — tightens tab padding/font-size for small phones. Everything else is fluid via clamp().

components.name: Tab
components.description: Top-level view switcher (Explore / Identify / Timeline / Compare).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d3c1; } .ds-tab { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #8a8371; background: none; border: none; padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; position: relative; top: 1px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1c1a15; } .ds-tab--active { color: #1c1a15; border-bottom-color: #a8391f; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a15; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Branch filter pill above the Explore card grid.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #514c3f; background: #fbf9f4; border: 1px solid #d9d3c1; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #8a8371; } .ds-chip--active { background: #1c1a15; border-color: #1c1a15; color: #f4f1ea; }

components.name: Branch Tag
components.description: Small tinted classification-branch label on cards and timeline rows — the system's only tinted (not solid) accent fill.
components.css: .ds-branch-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #a8391f; background: rgba(168,57,31,0.12); padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Spec Card
components.description: Explore-grid card: a classification's name, era, live specimen, tagline, and branch tag.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; text-align: left; background: #fbf9f4; border: 1px solid #d9d3c1; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #1c1a15; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #8a8371; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,26,21,.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(28,26,21,.18); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a15; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-card-era { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #8a8371; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-specimen { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.2rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-card-tagline { font-size: 0.83rem; color: #514c3f; margin: 0; }

components.name: Quiz Option
components.description: Full-width answer button in the Identify decision-tree quiz.
components.css: .ds-quiz-option { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #f4f1ea; border: 1px solid #d9d3c1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-quiz-option:hover { border-color: #a8391f; } .ds-quiz-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a15; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quiz-option-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; display: block; color: #1c1a15; } .ds-quiz-option-desc { color: #514c3f; font-size: 0.83rem; margin-top: 0.2rem; display: block; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The "try your own text" custom specimen field above the Explore grid.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Type or paste a word, name, or short phrase…" />
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #d9d3c1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbf9f4; color: #1c1a15; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8371; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1a15; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #8a8371; }

components.name: Anatomy Lens
components.description: Signature component: a circular magnifier that shows a live, 2.8x-scaled clone of the anatomy diagram under the cursor/touch point. Resting (hidden) and visible states shown; the live version's inner content is a cloned, transformed SVG rather than static text.
components.css: .ds-lens { position: relative; width: 170px; height: 170px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #1c1a15; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -4px rgba(28,26,21,.4); overflow: hidden; background: #fbf9f4; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.85); transition: opacity 0.12s ease, transform 0.12s ease; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-lens--visible { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-lens-inner { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 4rem; color: #1c1a15; }

components.name: Timeline Bar
components.description: Signature component: a classification's bar on the Gantt-style timeline, sitting over a lower-contrast era backdrop band, with a sealing-wax pin marker at its start.
components.html: <svg width="320" height="70" viewBox="0 0 320 70" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="0" y="10" width="320" height="50" fill="#d9d3c1" opacity="0.3" /><rect class="ds-tl-bar" x="40" y="22" width="200" height="26" rx="3" fill="#8a8371" /><circle cx="40" cy="35" r="4" fill="#a8391f" /><text x="52" y="39" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#fbf9f4">GARALDE OLDSTYLE</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-tl-bar { cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-tl-bar:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); }

narrative.overview:
Type Classified reads like a naturalist's logbook crossed with a type foundry's specimen book: warm parchment pages, ink-brown text, and each classification laid out and labeled like a catalogued specimen — measured, comparative, quietly authoritative. Nothing here performs; it records. The system exists to make a diagnostic legible (contrast, axis, serif shape, x-height) at a glance, then reward a closer look with real detail — a magnifiable anatomy diagram, a font rendered in its correct historical lineage, a timeline that places the specimen in its century.

The palette and type pairing commit to warm and unhurried over cold and efficient: a serif display face (Fraunces) for names and headings paired with a plain, quiet sans (Inter) for everything functional, sitting on parchment rather than white or near-black. The one color note — a sealing-wax red — is used the way a stamp or a wax seal is used: sparingly, to mark something as worth attention, never as a fill. This system explicitly rejects the flashy SaaS-dashboard register (no neon gradients, no glassmorphism, no dense KPI-tile chrome) and the cold-minimalist-tech register (no stark white/black, no monospace-everything) in favor of staying legible, precise, and warm throughout.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment surfaces, never true white or true black
A serif display face for identity and naming; a quiet sans for everything else
One accent color, used only as a mark (underline, tag, border, dot) — never a fill
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow appears only as a response to hover or an overlay opening
Diagnostic, comparative density — small uppercase tracked labels do a lot of the organizing work

rules.name: The Small Mark Rule
rules.body: Sealing Wax never fills a surface larger than a tag, a 3px border, or a 1-2px underline/pin. If an element needs to feel important, give it a mark in this color; do not give it a background in this color.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral-Only Rule
rules.body: No pure white (#fff) or pure black (#000) appears anywhere in the system, light or dark mode. Every neutral carries the same warm, slightly yellow-brown cast.

rules.name: The Whisper-Label Rule
rules.body: Every organizing label in the system (section headers, diagnostic tags, branch pills) is small, uppercase, letter-spaced, and colored ink-faint — quiet enough to never compete with the content it's labeling.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card, chip, or panel carries a shadow in its default state. Shadow is earned by hover or by floating above the page — never applied as ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep every neutral warm — background, text, and border colors all carry the same paper-and-ink cast; never introduce a cool gray or pure white/black.
Do use Sealing Wax only as a mark: an underline, a border, a tag tint, a dot, a pin. If it needs to fill a surface larger than a few px of border or a small tag, use ink instead.
Do pair Fraunces (names, headings, identity) with Inter (everything functional) — never use Fraunces for body copy or Inter for a classification's name.
Do leave cards and panels flat at rest; only add shadow in response to hover or when a surface floats above the page (modal, tooltip, popover, lens).
Do use the small-uppercase-tracked Label style for anything that organizes content rather than making it look like body copy.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism as decoration — this system explicitly rejects the flashy SaaS-dashboard register.
Don't introduce a second accent color. One mark color, used sparingly, is the entire palette's point.
Don't let corner radius exceed 10px on any surface, or drop to a sharp 0px.
Don't ship a font whose classification lineage is wrong for the sake of a better-looking specimen — accuracy is a harder constraint here than in almost any other kind of app.
